# Gnomish Lineage: Forest Gnome (`traits:gnomish-lineage-forest-gnome`)
**Species:** [Gnome](../species/gnome.md) | **Subspecies:** [Gnomish Lineage: Forest Gnome](../subspecies/gnomish-lineage-forest-gnome.md)
**Spells:** [Speak with Animals](../spells/speak-with-animals.md) (uses: Proficiency Bonus, recovery: Long Rest)

You always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.
